# Shipwright Studio

> Shipwright Studio is an independent engineering studio crafting websites, web apps, and AI infrastructure for startups and small teams. Based in the San Francisco Bay Area, working worldwide. Founded and run by a senior software engineer.

## Services

- **Custom website development**: Fast, accessible, search-friendly marketing sites and landing pages. Modern stack, no bloated templates.
- **Web application development**: Interactive dashboards, internal tools, and customer-facing apps — designed, engineered, and deployed end to end.
- **AI infrastructure**: LLM application engineering, inference cost optimization, GPU communication and distributed training performance.

## Selected work

- **Lumen** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lumen/): An interactive photography lab that teaches the exposure triangle (aperture, shutter speed, ISO) with real-time canvas simulations of depth of field, motion blur, noise, and light metering.
- **Forge** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/forge/): An LLM inference cost estimator. Enter model size, quantization, GPU type, batch size, and traffic to estimate GPU count, latency, and monthly serving cost.
- **The Lab** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/ideas/): An open bank of 52 web experiments — games, developer tools, browser extension prototypes, and small apps. Two new experiments are designed, built, and shipped every day. Recent additions: **Efficient Frontier Plotter** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lab/efficient-frontier/), a free online portfolio optimizer — enter expected returns, volatilities and correlations to compute and plot the Markowitz efficient frontier, with minimum-variance and maximum-Sharpe portfolios and hover-to-inspect weight mixes, all computed locally, **Flappy Flyer** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lab/flappy-flyer/), a free online arcade game — tap to fly through shrinking pipe gaps with score-scaled speed, local best-score persistence and retro sound effects, all in the browser, **Hangman** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lab/hangman/), a free online hangman game — guess the hidden word before the six-part drawing finishes, with four word categories, three difficulties, hints and streak tracking, all in the browser, **UUID Generator** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lab/uuid-generator/), a free online developer tool — bulk-generate v1, v4, v7 or nil UUIDs up to a thousand at a time, with one-click copy and .txt download, generated with the Web Crypto API so nothing leaves the page, **Tip & Split** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lab/tip-splitter/), a free online bill splitter — assign each dish to its diners with a tap, add tip and tax, and get every person's penny-exact share with a copy-ready group-chat summary, all computed locally, **Risk of Ruin Simulator** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lab/ruin-simulator/), a free online gambling-risk simulator — dial in bankroll, bet size, win probability and payout odds, then see the probability of ruin across thousands of Monte Carlo equity paths, with a Kelly-criterion hint, educational demo using simulated data only, **Connect Four vs AI** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lab/connect-four/), a free online connect-four game — play as red or yellow against a minimax AI in three difficulties or a friend locally, with animated disc drops, win-line highlights, undo and lifetime stats, all computed locally, **URL Codec** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lab/url-codec/), a free online developer tool — encode and decode URLs and query strings entirely in the browser, with Component vs Full-URL modes, a live query-parameter table with edit and rebuild, and precise malformed-sequence errors, nothing ever leaves the page, **Base64 Lab** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lab/base64-lab/), a free online developer tool — encode and decode Base64 text or files entirely in the browser, with auto-detect mode, a whitespace janitor that fixes broken pastes, byte stats and SHA-256 fingerprints, nothing ever leaves the page, **VWAP Tracker** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lab/vwap-tracker/), a free online trading-education tool — plot any intraday session against its volume-weighted average price with ±1σ and ±2σ deviation bands, replay the day bar by bar, scrub any bar for its values, paste custom price/volume data, or pick from three sample sessions, educational demo using synthetic data only
